firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently went to a concert is the first player.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise from that player.
internalEvidence: Allplay's Bebop product page https://allplay.com/board-games/bebop identifies the Bitewing Games edition for BGG identity 414349. The Bitewing-authored booklet was retrieved from Gamers HQ; its printed/PDF pages 5 and 12 were rendered and visually checked. Page 5 states the concert criterion and clockwise order. The credits on page 12 identify Bitewing Games and 2024. The 36-plus-MB PDF exceeded the default intake cap and was retrieved using its 150-MB bounded option. Mirror PDF SHA-256: 99244a9c1a8bc644373e8bce97d78800e663a945640ee699c62b14abf005a8e7. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The rules give no tie-break or fallback if nobody has been to a concert or several players last went together.
